description: The bar chart illustrates the GLUE performance of various fine-tuning methods for RoBERTa models of different sizes. The horizontal axis represents the fine-tuning methods, labeled as Prefix, Adaptor, LoRA, BitFit, S1-model, S4-model, and S5-model, in that order. The vertical axis is labeled "GLUE Performance" and has a linear scale ranging from approximately 85 to 89, with tick labels at intervals of 1. Each fine-tuning method is represented by a pair of bars, colored blue for the "base" RoBERTa size and orange for the "large" RoBERTa size, as indicated by the legend. The bar heights for the "base" size range from approximately 84.5 to 86.5, with LoRA having the highest value and BitFit having the lowest. For the "large" size, the bar heights range from approximately 85.5 to 88.5, with S5-model and Adaptor having the highest values and S1-model having the lowest. The bars are grouped by fine-tuning method, with the "base" and "large" sizes appearing side by side. The chart does not display any specific sorting order for the bars beyond the fixed order of the fine-tuning methods on the horizontal axis.
